local_checks.invariant: Contributor-controlled code (pull_request from a fork) never runs with write tokens or repository secrets
local_checks.result: ci.yml:6 triggers on pull_request; ci.yml:8-9 sets permissions: contents: read at workflow level; no job overrides it and no `secrets.*` expression exists anywhere under .github/. The PR head is checked out (ci.yml:15) and its own package.json scripts run (install/lint/test/build, ci.yml:23-33) but `DEPLOY_CONVEX` is unset so package.json:15 takes the plain `pnpm build:app` branch and no deploy key is present. No `${{ }}` expression is interpolated into a `run:` step, so no expression injection. Runner secret defaults for fork PRs are a hosted fact, but even if secrets were exposed nothing references them. No finding.

local_checks.invariant: The only workflow with contents: write is triggered solely by trusted writers and does not interpolate untrusted data into shell
local_checks.result: release-tag.yml:19-20 grants contents: write; triggers are workflow_dispatch and push to main filtered to .template-version/CHANGELOG.md (lines 12-17), both require push/write access. The version is read from the checked-out file (line 29), every use is double-quoted (lines 31, 35, 39, 40); `grep -q "^## $version"` treats it as a regex and `echo ::error::` echoes it as a workflow command, but the writer is a main pusher who already holds the same authority. No expression injection. No finding.

local_checks.invariant: Build inputs consumed by CI are immutable or bound to a reviewed identity
local_checks.result: actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4 (ci.yml:15,19,48,50,62,64; release-tag.yml:26) and pnpm/action-setup@v4 (ci.yml:18) are floating major tags, not commit SHAs. The trust root is the GitHub `actions` org (and the pnpm org for a read-only job); a retag would reach the contents: write job in release-tag.yml. No lower-trust writer is source-visible, so this is hardening (pin to SHA), not a finding. pnpm itself is bound by packageManager sha512 (package.json:6) read by pnpm/action-setup with no `version:` override.

local_checks.invariant: No third-party package version reaches the production build/deploy path without human review
local_checks.result: renovate.json:13-18 auto-merges every patch/minor devDependency update once CI is green; config:recommended (line 3) sets no minimumReleaseAge and neither .npmrc:1-2 nor pnpm-workspace.yaml:1-3 sets a pnpm cooldown. package.json:16 `build:app` runs `vite build && tsc`, executing devDependency code (vite.config.ts:3-5 loads vite-tsconfig-paths, @tailwindcss/vite, @vitejs/plugin-react; package.json:86,92,97,100-102), and package.json:15 wraps that in `npx convex deploy --cmd` when DEPLOY_CONVEX=true. KNOWN_ISSUES.md:370-383 and README.md:115,133,147-149 document that every push to main auto-deploys on Scalingo with the production CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY available during the build. A malicious or compromised patch release of any of those devDependencies would therefore be merged and executed with the production deploy key without any human reading it. Hosted facts (Renovate installed, branch protection, Scalingo config) are not source-visible; raised as needs_validation candidate.

local_checks.invariant: A vendored skill file is written only inside .agents/skills/<name>/ and only from the pinned upstream commit
local_checks.result: relPaths() (sync-skills.mjs:109-111) takes `references` verbatim from the lock and vendor() writes to resolve(dir, f.rel) (lines 193-195) with no check that the result stays under dir; an absolute or `../` entry would write outside the skill directory (CLAUDE.md states the descendant rule but nothing enforces it). local_checks.invariant: Every candidate write is gated on the server clock, never on the caller's now
local_checks.result: acceptConsent (127), updateProfile (163), resolveDocumentUpload (200) and swapDocumentKey (287) call evaluateSessionGate with Date.now() and reject unless ready/resumable; the gate blocks completed/cancelled/expired sessions and archived/draft/expired projects (sessionState.ts:67-78). local_checks.invariant: A candidate never names the object key that is written or attached: keys are derived from the resolved session and re-derived on attach
local_checks.result: resolveDocumentUpload derives the PUT key from session.orgId/session._id/kind/extension (221-226) with extension from a fixed allow-list (60-65) and signs content-type and content-length; swapDocumentKey re-derives the prefix orgs/{orgId}/sessions/{sessionId}/{kind}. and rejects any key outside it (299-305), so the replaced object that attachDocument deletes (327) is always inside the caller's own session prefix. local_checks.invariant: Expiry arithmetic: expiresInDays produces an expiresAt that resolveShare honours for every accepted number, the boundary instant behaves as documented, and the holder's clock can only shorten, never extend, a share's life.
local_checks.result: Replaying the create() expression (convex/shares.ts:119-122) and the resolveShare comparison (60-62) with the real effectiveNow and looksLikeToken: 7/30/0/0.5 days expire as expected; -1 and -Infinity are dead at creation; NaN, Infinity, 1e300 and MAX_SAFE_INTEGER yield an expiresAt that never compares below now, i.e. a permanent share carrying a garbage expiry (Convex accepts NaN/Infinity per convex/_generated/ai/guidelines.md:76). expiresAt === now is still active (strict <). effectiveNow clamps a past clientNow to real-60000 ms and honours any future clientNow, so a holder can only make a share look expired earlier. The dialog only ever sends 7, 30 or null (ShareReportDialog.tsx:31,154). The same recruiter can already choose null (no expiry), so the NaN/Infinity path crosses no boundary: recorded as hardening (validate expiresInDays as a finite positive integer).

local_checks.invariant: View counting is atomic and cannot be inflated or lost by concurrent viewers, and the counter write is bounded by a limiter keyed on the share.

Inflation by the holder is self-limited by the limiter and affects only a display counter.
